# Marco Antonio Gutiérrez Garduño (Aguila)

Mathematics · Differentiala Geometriaaaaaaa · Spectral Geometry probando muchas cosas

Welcome to my academic websitee. I am a mathematician interested in geometry, analysis, and the interaction between geometric structures and differential operators.

## About me

I am currently pursuing a master's degree in Mathematical Sciences at the Institute of Mathematics, National Autonomous University of Mexico (UNAM), in Cuernavaca.

My research focuses on the Dirac operator and spectral asymmetry on spherical three-manifolds. More broadly, I am interested in differential geometry, spin geometry, spectral theory, topology, and representation theory.

## Research interests

- Spin geometry and Dirac operators
- Spectral geometry and spectral asymmetry
- Differential geometry and topology
- Representation theory and global analysis
